properties.description: Drives search_design through the MCP surface on a design that declares tracked designs. Asserts: (1) a node held ONLY in a tracked design's export is returned under that design, and the design's own hits are unchanged; (2) a design watched at an address is searched on a stand-in server with the key sent; (3) a missing export, a design declared with nowhere to read it, and an address on a server that does not reach out each come back with their state and a sentence, never as an empty hit list alone; (4) without `tracked_designs` the reply carries no `tracked_designs` key (regression); (5) a design that tracks nothing says so. Written to fail before the parameter exists.
properties.name: A tracked-designs search finds a node that only a tracked design holds, and names each tracked design it could not search
